source.command: uci -q show network | awk -F= '/\.vid=/ {gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$2);print $2}' | sort -nu | tr '\n' ' '

wifi.description: Active AP interfaces discovered using iw. Wi-Fi band is derived from operating frequency.

source.command: for iface in $(iw dev 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="Interface"{print $2}'); do case "$iface" in mon*|*mon) continue;; esac; iw dev "$iface" info 2>/dev/null | awk -v iface="$iface" 'function esc(s){gsub(/\\/,"\\\\",s);gsub(/"/,"\\\"",s);return s} BEGIN{ssid="";channel="";frequency=0;type=""} /^[[:space:]]*ssid /{sub(/^[[:space:]]*ssid /,"",$0);ssid=$0} /^[[:space:]]*channel /{channel=$2;frequency=$3;gsub(/[()]/,"",frequency)} /^[[:space:]]*type /{type=$2} END{if(type=="AP" && frequency ~ /^[0-9]+$/){band=(frequency<3000?"2g":(frequency<5925?"5g":"6g"));printf "{\"ifname\":\"%s\",\"ssid\":\"%s\",\"channel\":\"%s\",\"frequency\":%d,\"band\":\"%s\"}\n",esc(iface),esc(ssid),channel,frequency,band}}'; done

clients.description: Associated Wi-Fi stations discovered using iw station dump. SSID is resolved from the AP interface, IP and hostname are resolved from DHCP leases by client MAC.

source.command:
leases="$(ubus call dhcp ipv4leases 2>/dev/null)"; for iface in $(iw dev 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="Interface"{print $2}'); do case "$iface" in mon*|*mon) continue;; esac; info="$(iw dev "$iface" info 2>/dev/null)"; freq="$(printf '%s
' "$info" | awk '/^[[:space:]]*channel /{f=$3;gsub(/[()]/,"",f);print f;exit}')"; [ -n "$freq" ] || continue; case "$freq" in *[!0-9]*) continue;; esac; if [ "$freq" -lt 3000 ]; then band=2g; elif [ "$freq" -lt 5925 ]; then band=5g; else band=6g; fi; ssid="$(printf '%s
' "$info" | awk '/^[[:space:]]*ssid /{sub(/^[[:space:]]*ssid /,"");print;exit}')"; iw dev "$iface" station dump 2>/dev/null | awk -v iface="$iface" -v band="$band" -v ssid="$ssid" -v leases="$leases" 'function n(x){return (x ~ /^-?[0-9]+$/)?x:0} function rate(x){sub(/^[^:]*:[ 	]*/,"",x);sub(/[ 	].*$/, "", x);sub(/[^0-9.].*$/, "", x);return x} function esc(s){gsub(/\/,"\\",s);gsub(/"/,"\"",s);return s} function jsonget(idx,field,    cmd,v){cmd="printf %s "" leases "" | jsonfilter -q -e "@.leases[" idx "]." field "" 2>/dev/null"; cmd | getline v; close(cmd); return v} function lookup(mac,    i,m,v){clientip="";clienthost="";for(i=0;i<128;i++){m=jsonget(i,"macaddr");if(m=="")break;if(tolower(m)==tolower(mac)){clientip=jsonget(i,"ipaddr");clienthost=jsonget(i,"hostname");break}} if(clientip==""){cmd="ip neigh 2>/dev/null | awk \047tolower($5)==tolower("" mac "") && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+\./ {print $1;exit}\047";cmd | getline v;close(cmd);clientip=v}} function emit(){if(mac!=""){lookup(mac);printf "{"ap":"%s","ssid":"%s","ip":"%s","hostname":"%s","mac":"%s","signal":%d,"signal_avg":%d,"connected":%d,"lastcommunication":%d,"idle":%d,"interface":"%s","band":"%s","rx":%d,"tx":%d,"rx_bytes":%d,"tx_bytes":%d,"rx_packets":%d,"tx_packets":%d,"tx_retries":%d,"tx_failed":%d,"rx_drop_misc":%d,"rxrate":"%sM","txrate":"%sM","expected_throughput":"%s"}
",iface,esc(ssid),esc(clientip),esc(clienthost),mac,signal,signalavg,connected,connected,idle,iface,band,rx,tx,rx,tx,rxpackets,txpackets,txretries,txfailed,rxdrop,rxrate,txrate,expected}} /^[[:space:]]*Station /{emit();mac=$2;signal=0;signalavg=0;rx=0;tx=0;rxpackets=0;txpackets=0;txretries=0;txfailed=0;rxdrop=0;rxrate="0";txrate="0";expected="";connected=0;idle=0} $1=="signal:"{signal=n($2)} $1=="signal"&&$2=="avg:"{signalavg=n($3)} $1=="rx"&&$2=="bytes:"{rx=n($3)} $1=="tx"&&$2=="bytes:"{tx=n($3)} $1=="rx"&&$2=="packets:"{rxpackets=n($3)} $1=="tx"&&$2=="packets:"{txpackets=n($3)} $1=="tx"&&$2=="retries:"{txretries=n($3)} $1=="tx"&&$2=="failed:"{txfailed=n($3)} $1=="rx"&&$2=="drop"&&$3=="misc:"{rxdrop=n($4)} $1=="rx"&&$2=="bitrate:"{rxrate=rate($0)} $1=="tx"&&$2=="bitrate:"{txrate=rate($0)} $1=="expected"&&$2=="throughput:"{expected=$3} $1=="connected"&&$2=="time:"{connected=n($3)} $1=="inactive"&&$2=="time:"{idle=int(n($3)/1000)} END{emit()}' ; done
